name: MonarchBreadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow of MonarchLink in the subtle style, with a ghost MonarchButton that opens androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu and DropdownMenuItem for the collapsed levels
summary: A trail of the levels above the current screen, the current level last, with the middle levels of a long trail collapsed into a menu.
whenToUse: For deep hierarchies the person moves up and down, such as folders, document trees or nested settings, where knowing and jumping to an ancestor helps.
whenNotToUse: On ordinary screens: the top app bar's title and back button already say where the person is. For moving between sections of one screen, use tabs.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBreadcrumb(items: List<MonarchBreadcrumbItem>, onItemClick: (MonarchBreadcrumbItem) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, maxVisible: Int = 4, enabled: Boolean = true, separator: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchBreadcrumbLabels = MonarchBreadcrumbLabels())
class MonarchBreadcrumbItem(title: String, id: String = title, linked: Boolean = true)
class MonarchBreadcrumbLabels(label: String? = null, more: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, current: String? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The levels from the root to the current screen. Each has a title, an id (the title by default) and linked.

options.name: onItemClick
options.description: Goes to the chosen level, for example by popping the back stack. Not called for the last level or for a level that is not linked.

options.name: maxVisible
options.description: The most levels shown. Above it the first level stays, the middle levels collapse into a menu and the last maxVisible - 2 stay. Values below 3 count as 3.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the links and the menu can be used. When not, they use the disabled text color.

options.name: separator
options.description: Replaces the separator, a single angle quotation mark that mirrors right to left. Hidden from TalkBack.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the TalkBack name of the trail ("Breadcrumb"), of the menu button ("Show 3 more levels") and of the current level's state ("Current page").

states.name: linked ancestor
states.description: A MonarchLink in the subtle style: muted text, underlined while pressed or focused.

states.name: not linked
states.description: An ancestor with linked = false is muted text, and a disabled item in the collapsed menu.

states.name: current
states.description: The last level is text in the default color and a medium weight, never a link.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: An ellipsis button in the ghost style stands for the middle levels and opens a DropdownMenu of them.

states.name: overflowing
states.description: When the trail is wider than the space it scrolls sideways; it starts scrolled to the current level.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false every link and the menu button are disabled and use the disabled text color.

appearance: Links in the muted text color, the current level in the default text color and medium weight, and separators in the subtle text color, on whatever surface holds the trail. The menu uses the Material 3 menu colors Monarch maps to the raised surface. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web Breadcrumb is a nav of links with href and a linkAs component. On Android each level calls onItemClick, so the app pops its back stack or loads the folder, as on iOS. The web's locale prop is not needed: the hidden count is formatted by the plurals resource in the app's locale. A web item without href is linked = false. Monarch bundles no icons, so the web's chevron separator is a mirrored text character, and a separator slot takes the app's own glyph. The plan's LazyRow is used, which also keeps a long trail on one line instead of wrapping it.
accessibility: The trail is one traversal group named "Breadcrumb" (replaceable with labels.label); TalkBack moves through its levels in order.
Ancestors are links with their title as the name and a 48dp touch target. The last level is text with the state "Current page".
The separators are hidden from TalkBack.
The collapsed-levels button is named "Show 3 more levels" from a plurals resource and has a 48dp touch target; levels without a screen are disabled in its menu.
Text scales with the font size and stays on one line; the trail scrolls instead of cutting a title.
The default separator is a mirrored character, so it points the reading direction in right-to-left layouts.
edgeCases: One level shows only the current level, with no separator and no link.
maxVisible below 3 counts as 3: the first level, the menu and the last level.
Levels with the same title need distinct ids when the app tells them apart.

examples.title: Collapsed trail
examples.template:
MonarchBreadcrumb(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem({{items.0}}),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem({{items.1}}),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem({{items.2}}),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem({{items.3}}),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem({{items.4}}, linked = false),
    ),
    onItemClick = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchBreadcrumb(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem("Workspace"),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem("Projects"),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem("Website"),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem("Sprint 4"),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem("Fix sign-in redirect", linked = false),
    ),
    onItemClick = {},
)

examples.title: A level without a screen, and ids that differ from the titles
examples.code:
MonarchBreadcrumb(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem(title = "Settings", id = "settings"),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem(title = "Workspace", id = "workspace", linked = false),
        MonarchBreadcrumbItem(title = "Members", id = "members"),
    ),
    onItemClick = { /* Pop the back stack to item.id. */ },
)
